notes.title: Right Before Release!! Demo Update (Super Tax City Demo 0.5.0)
notes.notes:
Only 10 Days Until the Full Version Release!!
We’re rolling out a major update to the demo ahead of the release!

This update introduces the new "Tile Function" and adds 10 new items.
You can now enjoy gameplay closer to the experience of the full version!

After the release of the full version, the demo will be adjusted into a smaller-scale version.
Until then, enjoy the updated demo as we count down to launch!

If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned for the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881800

Follow us on our social media accounts to communicate with us and get the latest game updates!
Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/Tc8d6xyxkf]Super Tax City[/url]

Update Details:
- 10 new items added
- Shop adjustments
- New tile functionality
- Adjustments to building and item effects
- Added a detailed tutorial

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Exclusive Update & Full Version Giveaway Campaign
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest Has Started!

To celebrate the Steam Next Fest, Super Tax City is hosting a special 
"Limited-Time Stage Release" and a "Full Version Steam Key Giveaway Campaign"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925590/b5c91ff4011a28db8cdeea4e17f68cbdf1c30a71.png[/img]
[h3]Steam Next Fest Exclusive Update[/h3]
A special Next Fest-exclusive stage is now available for a limited time! Experience a stage where you start with special items. This stage will be playable from now until the end of the Next Fest.

[h3]Full Version Giveaway Campaign[/h3]
During the Steam Next Fest, if you clear the exclusive stage and post a screenshot in the official Discord server, you will be entered into a lottery for a chance to win a full version key of the game when it releases! 20 lucky winners will be chosen.

[How to Participate]
1.Take a screenshot of the screen that appears when you clear the exclusive stage.
2.Join the official Discord server [https://discord.gg/Tc8d6xyxkf].
3.Post your screenshot in the ⁠🎉nextfest channel on the official Discord.

If you haven’t already, please add the game to your wishlist during this special opportunity!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881800

notes.title: Demo Update: New Feature "Shop" Added!
notes.notes:
We have released an update for Super Tax City Demo! 
This update introduces the brand-new "Shop Feature."

[h2][Shop Feature][/h2]
Instead of obtaining items after clearing each stage, you can now freely shop in the "Shop."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925590/debbef115752d7255d7315d130e068fa2b5e3f75.png[/img]

In the "Shop" you can use "Shop Coins" obtained during the stage to purchase "Items" or "Power-ups".

Power-ups include actions like "Constructing Specific Facilities", "Leveling Up Random Facilities", or "Purchasing Resources", allowing you to further strengthen your build. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925590/1b02dc4c75dd606e2ce583fdbc89dc25a9e92b7c.png[/img]

For full patch notes, check here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881800/view/4699033840155427516

We hope you enjoy this update and we would love to hear your feedback over on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tc8d6xyxkf]Discord[/url]!
And if you haven’t already, please wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881800

Cheers & Thank you very much,

notes.title: [Demo Release] Experience "Super Tax City" early!
notes.notes:
The demo version of "Super Tax City" is now available!
The demo includes the following features:
1) Over 50 types of facilities
2) More than 20 items
3) Exclusive stages
4) Ranking system
5) Record-keeping feature
There's plenty of content to enjoy in the demo alone, so be sure to give it a try!
"Super Tax City" will continue to evolve as we move towards the full release.
Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for the latest updates!
